summary: Cheating During Testing is a Roblox game in beta by @ebenxzy. Players complete timed tests, attempt to cheat without being seen by the teacher, earn Credits based on their performance, manage Anxiety, purchase equipment, and decide whether to cooperate with other players who may betray them.
coreMechanics: Complete tests before the timer expires.
Cheat while avoiding detection by the teacher.
Earn Credits by completing tests, with higher grades providing larger rewards.
Purchase cheating gadgets and equipment to improve the player's chances.
Cooperate with friends while accounting for possible betrayal by Snitches.

entities.notes: Tests are timed activities that players must complete.
The teacher can see players cheating, so avoiding detection is a central challenge.
Credits are earned from completed tests and can also motivate Snitches to betray other players.
Grades affect rewards, with higher grades granting larger rewards.
Players can purchase cheating gadgets to improve their chances during tests; individual gadget names are not provided.
Purchasable equipment contributes to the player's gameplay loadout, but specific equipment is not identified.
Anxiety is a resource or status that players must manage during an exam; its exact effects are not stated.
Snitches can expose other players in exchange for Credits.
Players can build a loadout, apparently using purchased gadgets and equipment.
Players can team up with friends, although trust and betrayal are part of the interaction.
The supplied sources do not confirm an official redeemable-code system.
The supplied sources do not confirm that pets exist.
A teacher and Snitches are mentioned as roles, but no named character roster is documented.
